servicesPage.intro: At Kars Auto Shop, we offer a full range of auto repair and maintenance services designed to keep your vehicle running smoothly. From routine oil changes to complex engine repairs, our skilled mechanics have you covered.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Accurate diagnostics and expert engine repair to restore performance.
services.longDescription: Our advanced diagnostic tools quickly identify engine issues, from check engine lights to performance problems. We provide thorough repairs using quality parts to ensure long-lasting results.
benefits: Transparent pricing before any work begins

process.title: Comprehensive Scan
process.description: We connect your vehicle to our diagnostic system to read error codes and live data.

process.title: Detailed Explanation
process.description: Our mechanic walks you through the findings and discusses repair options.

process.title: Quality Repair
process.description: We perform the repair with precision, then test-drive to confirm the fix.

faqs.question: How long does an engine diagnostic take?
faqs.answer: Most diagnostics are completed within 1-2 hours, depending on the complexity.

faqs.question: Do you offer payment plans for major repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we work with financing partners to help you manage larger repair costs.

services.title: Brake Service & Repair
services.shortDescription: Complete brake inspections, pad replacement, and rotor resurfacing.
services.longDescription: Your safety is our priority. We inspect every component of your braking system and recommend only necessary repairs. Our brake services restore stopping power and extend the life of your system.
benefits: Thorough inspection of pads, rotors, calipers, and lines
Use of premium brake components for reliability

process.title: Brake Inspection
process.description: We remove wheels and measure pad thickness, rotor condition, and fluid levels.

process.title: Recommendation
process.description: We provide a detailed report and explain what needs attention.

process.title: Installation & Test
process.description: We install quality parts and perform a road test to ensure smooth operation.

faqs.question: How often should I replace my brake pads?
faqs.answer: Typically every 30,000-50,000 miles, but it depends on driving habits. We inspect them at every visit.

faqs.question: Can you fix a soft brake pedal?
faqs.answer: Yes, soft pedals often indicate air in the lines or a fluid leak. We'll diagnose and repair the issue.

services.title: Oil Change & Fluid Services
services.shortDescription: Keep your engine protected with regular oil changes and fluid checks.
services.longDescription: Routine oil changes are the simplest way to extend engine life. We use high-quality oils and filters, and check all other fluids to keep your car running efficiently.
benefits: Complimentary fluid top-off with every change

process.title: Drain Old Oil
process.description: We safely drain the old oil and replace the filter.

process.title: Refill with Quality Oil
process.description: We add the correct viscosity oil for your vehicle.

process.title: Multi-Point Check
process.description: We inspect fluids, belts, hoses, and tire pressure.

faqs.question: Which oil is best for my car?
faqs.answer: We recommend the oil grade specified in your owner's manual. We carry both conventional and synthetic.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Most modern cars need oil every 5,000-7,500 miles. We'll remind you when it's time.

services.title: AC & Heating System Repair
services.shortDescription: Keep your cabin comfortable with expert AC and heater service.
services.longDescription: Whether it's a hot Texas summer or a chilly winter morning, our technicians can diagnose and repair your vehicle's climate control system. From refrigerant recharge to compressor replacement, we do it all.
benefits: Heater core and blend door repairs

process.title: System Inspection
process.description: We check refrigerant pressure, compressor operation, and airflow.

process.title: Leak Detection
process.description: Using electronic detectors and UV dye, we find any leaks.

process.title: Repair & Recharge
process.description: We fix the issue and recharge the system to factory specs.

faqs.question: Why is my AC blowing warm air?
faqs.answer: Common causes include low refrigerant, a faulty compressor, or an electrical issue. We'll diagnose the root cause.

faqs.question: How often should I service my car's AC?
faqs.answer: We recommend an AC check every two years to ensure optimal performance and catch small issues early.

about.headline: Dallas' Trusted Auto Repair Since 2003
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality auto repair services that keep our community safe on the road.
story: Kars Auto Shop was founded in 2003 by master mechanic Carlos M. with a simple vision: create a repair shop where customers are treated like family. Starting with a small two-bay garage on Kline Drive, Carlos built a reputation for integrity and technical skill that quickly spread throughout Dallas. Over the years, we've grown to a full-service facility with six bays and a team of ASE-certified technicians, but our core values remain unchanged.

We invest in the latest diagnostic technology and continuous training so that we can service modern vehicles with confidence. From the first handshake to the final test drive, we prioritize clear communication and quality workmanship. Every car that leaves our shop is a testament to our commitment to excellence.
